        [114234929420007] = {name = "BloxStrike", module = "bloxstrike"},
        [8307114974] = {name = "Operation One", module = "OperationOne"},
    }
}

local placeId = game.PlaceId
local gameId = game.GameId
local gameInfo = CONFIG.SUPPORTED_GAMES[placeId] or CONFIG.SUPPORTED_GAMES[gameId]

local function loadModule(path)
    local cacheBuster = "?t=" .. tostring(math.floor(tick() * 1000))
    local url = CONFIG.REPO .. "/" .. path .. cacheBuster
    local success, result = pcall(function()
        return game:HttpGet(url, true)
    end)
    if not success or not result or result == "" then
        warn("[Infinite Zen] Falha ao carregar: " .. path)
        return nil
    end
    local fn = loadstring(result)
    if not fn then
        warn("[Infinite Zen] Erro de sintaxe em: " .. path)
        return nil
    end
    return fn
end

-- ═══ LOAD COMPAT LAYER ═══
local Compat
local okCompat, CompatResult = pcall(function()
    return loadModule("src/utils/compat.lua")()
end)
if okCompat and CompatResult then
    Compat = CompatResult
    print("[Infinite Zen] ✅ Compat layer carregada")
    Compat.report()
else
    warn("[Infinite Zen] ⚠️ Compat layer falhou, usando fallbacks internos")
    Compat = {
        getExecutor = function() return "Unknown" end,
        getHWID = function() return tostring(LocalPlayer.UserId) end,
        mouseClick = function() if mouse1click then pcall(mouse1click) end end,
        mouseMove = function(dx, dy) if mousemoverel then pcall(mousemoverel, dx, dy) end end,
        fireTouch = function(p, t, toggle) if firetouchinterest then pcall(firetouchinterest, p, t, toggle) end end,
        writeFile = function(p, c) if writefile then pcall(writefile, p, c) end end,
        readFile = function(p) if readfile then local ok, r = pcall(readfile, p); return ok and r or nil end end,
        fileExists = function(p) if isfile then local ok, r = pcall(isfile, p); return ok and r or false end end,
        folderExists = function(p) if isfolder then local ok, r = pcall(isfolder, p); return ok and r or false end end,
        makeFolder = function(p) if makefolder then pcall(makefolder, p) end end,
        deleteFile = function(p) if delfile then pcall(delfile, p) end end,
        listFiles = function(p) if listfiles then local ok, r = pcall(listfiles, p); return ok and r or {} end end,
        setClipboard = function(t) if setclipboard then pcall(setclipboard, t) end end,
        hasDrawing = function() return Drawing ~= nil end,
        newDrawing = function(class, props)
            if not Drawing then return nil end
            local d = Drawing.new(class)
            if props then for k, v in pairs(props) do d[k] = v end end
            return d
        end,
        report = function() return {} end,
    }
end

-- ═══ LOAD UI LIBRARY ═══

local Language = loadModule("src/utils/language.lua")()

features
- Wall ESP — every hostile gets a vis-box on the head plus a live distance tag. Boxes update in real time: green means a clear bullet path, red means cover between you and him. Round-robin visibility pass, no target starvation, no fps hit.
- Silent Aim — FOV 140 lock that never snaps your camera. Refreshes at 33Hz against live target positions so moving NPCs are tracked in real time. Sticky target logic stops crosshair flicker. Head / Root aim switchable in the UI.
- Aggressive Wallbang — spawns the round 0.5m from his skull and skips all cover, regardless of wall thickness. Works seamstessly with Silent Aim; spread cone at that distance is ~0, so every shot lands.
- No Recoil + No Spread — recoil killed at the source (impulse null), spread zeroed per-shot with instant restore. No weapons jam, no camera freeze, reload stays functional.
- Fullbright — kills shadows and fog, near-daylight visibility.
- Smart target priority — a visible target always beats a walled one; walled targets only get engaged when wallbang is on. Other NPCs' bodies never count as walls.
- Self-protection — auto-detects your own third-person body and never locks it. Crosshair eats enemies, not your own skull.
- Live HUD — active-feature pill, target count, FPS counter.
- UI — click-drag anywhere, minimize, INSERT to toggle visibility, one-tap UNLOAD restores everything clean.
what's new in v2.3
- rebuilt spread handling — the old gun-jam on fire is gone
- recoil now killed via impulse null only — no camera freeze, no stuck reloads
- better vis-aim sync — ESP color now matches exactly what aim will lock
- faster, lighter core; rapid-fire and big-mag removed for stability
usage
load with your executor in PVE mode. paste, pick a mode, toggle features. INSERT hides the panel.

PVP build is in active development — real-player targeting on the same core. follow for release when it drops.

local function getDateInfo()
	local d=os.date("*t")

	if not d then
		return "--:--:--","Fecha no disponible"
	end

	local timeText=string.format(
		"%02d:%02d:%02d",
		d.hour,
		d.min,
		d.sec
	)

	local dateText=string.format(
		"%s, %d de %s de %d",
		Days[d.wday] or "",
		d.day,
		Months[d.month] or "",
		d.year
	)

	return timeText,dateText
end

local LastAttacker=nil

local function findAttacker()
	local char=Player.Character

	if not char then
		return
	end

	local root=char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	if not root then
		return
	end

	local closest,dist=nil,18

	for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if p~=Player and p.Character then
			local r=p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

			if r then
				local d=(r.Position-root.Position).Magnitude

				if d<dist then
					dist=d
					closest=p
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return closest
end

local function findClosestPlayer()
	local char=Player.Character

	if not char then
		return
	end

	local root=char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	if not root then
		return
	end

	local closest,dist=nil,math.huge

	for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if p~=Player and p.Character then
			local r=p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local h=p.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")

			if r and h and h.Health>0 then
				local d=(r.Position-root.Position).Magnitude

				if d<dist then
					dist=d
					closest=p
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return closest
end
